lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

      simpa using this

  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by

    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon

noncomputable def toQuaternion (z : 𝓞) : ℍ where

noncomputable def fromQuaternion (z : ℍ) : 𝓞 where
  re := Int.floor <| z.re + z.imJ
  im_o := Int.floor <| z.imJ + z.imK
  im_i := Int.floor <| z.imI - z.imK
  im_oi := Int.floor <| z.imJ - z.imK

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]

⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>

    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

      rw [range_one, sum_singleton, add_zero]
      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)

    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val

      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]

      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>

    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

  | add x y hx hy =>

    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  simp [hNz]

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/

  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),

    peel hx with D N hD hx

  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]

    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]

  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, 1 < j ∧ a < ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! := by
      refine ⟨a + 2, ?_, ?_⟩

      rw [sum_range_add]
      apply lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt
      · positivity
      rw [range_one, sum_singleton, add_zero]
      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega

        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_

        have := sum_factorial_lt_two_mul_factorial this
        gcongr
      · rw [add_zero]
        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]

    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val

      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_

      apply lt_sub_of_add_lt

        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]

        mod_eq_of_lt this]

lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]

    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]

      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)

    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val

      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]

        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_

      · gcongr

lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by
      nth_rw 1 [← hl, ← Rat.num_div_den l, ← mul_one ((l.num : ℚ) / l.den), div_mul_comm,

    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon

  rw [eq_top_iff]

  rcases ZHat.nat_dense N z with ⟨q, r, hz, _⟩

  · simp

  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  simp [hNz]

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

  · intro h

      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

      have := congrArg (TensorProduct.lid ℤ ZHat) h
      simpa using this

  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by

    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon
    use l.num; rw [hx, (unique _ 1 _ r ⟨hNz, cop2, hcanon.symm⟩).1]

  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD

open BigOperators Nat Finset in
/-- A nonarchimedean analogue `0! + 1! + 2! + ⋯` of `e = 1/0! + 1/1! + 1/2! + ⋯`.
It is defined as the function whose value at `ZMod n` is the sum of `i!` for `0 ≤ i < n`.-/
def e : ZHat := ⟨fun (n : ℕ+) ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n : ℕ), i !, by
  intros D N hDN
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_add_of_le <| le_of_dvd N.pos hDN
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_natCast, hk, sum_range_add, add_right_eq_self]
  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

      refine ⟨a + 2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lt_add_iff_pos_left, add_pos_iff, zero_lt_one, or_true]
      rw [sum_range_add]
      apply lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt
      · positivity
      rw [range_one, sum_singleton, add_zero]
      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega
      calc
        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_
      · rw [mul_one]
        have : 3 ≤ a + 3 := by omega
        have := sum_factorial_lt_two_mul_factorial this
        gcongr
      · rw [add_zero]
        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]
        ring
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    calc
      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_
      _ = (e N).val := ?_
    · dsimp [N]
      apply lt_sub_of_add_lt
      rwa [add_comm, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast,
        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]

      rw [ha, intCast_val, Int.cast_negSucc, ZMod.neg_val, ZMod.val_natCast, if_neg,
        mod_eq_of_lt this]
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]

lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

      have := congrArg (TensorProduct.lid ℤ ZHat) h
      simpa using this

  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by

    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon
    use l.num; rw [hx, (unique _ 1 _ r ⟨hNz, cop2, hcanon.symm⟩).1]

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD

  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]

    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega
      calc
        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_

        gcongr
      · rw [add_zero]
        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]

    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val

      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_
      _ = (e N).val := ?_

      apply lt_sub_of_add_lt
      rwa [add_comm, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast,
        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]

        mod_eq_of_lt this]
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

  rcases ZHat.nat_dense N z with ⟨q, r, hz, _⟩

  use ((r : ℤ) / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 1
  constructor
  · simp

  nth_rw 2 [this]
  rw [mul_comm, ← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  simp [hNz]

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/

  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]

deriving CommRing

/-- A nonarchimedean analogue `0! + 1! + 2! + ⋯` of `e = 1/0! + 1/1! + 1/2! + ⋯`.
It is defined as the function whose value at `ZMod n` is the sum of `i!` for `0 ≤ i < n`.-/
def e : ZHat := ⟨fun (n : ℕ+) ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n : ℕ), i !, by
  intros D N hDN
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_add_of_le <| le_of_dvd N.pos hDN
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_natCast, hk, sum_range_add, add_right_eq_self]
  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by
  let r : ℕ := (z N : ZMod N).val
  have h : (z - r) N = 0 := by change z N - r = 0; simp [r]
  rw [← multiples] at h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

lemma rat_meet_zHat : ratsub ⊓ zHatsub = zsub := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by
      nth_rw 1 [← hl, ← Rat.num_div_den l, ← mul_one ((l.num : ℚ) / l.den), div_mul_comm,
      mul_comm, ← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [← PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos, hx] at hcanon
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := unique _ _ _ _ ⟨hNz, cop1, hcanon⟩
    have : 1 = 1 / (((1 : ℕ+) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp
    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon
    use l.num; rw [hx, (unique _ 1 _ r ⟨hNz, cop2, hcanon.symm⟩).1]

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>

    simp

    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩

  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  simp [hNz]

        mod_eq_of_lt this]

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>

    (f : M → N) (one : f 1 = 1) (mul : ∀ x y : M, f (x * y) = f x * f y) (z : M) (n : ℕ) :
    f (npowRec n z) = (f z) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [npowRec, one, pow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [npowRec, pow_succ, mul, ih]

C1_dependencies.name: npowRec
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The fundamental power operation in a monoid. `npowRec n a = a*a*...*a` n times.
Use instead `a ^ n`, which has better definitional behavior. -/
def npowRec [One M] [Mul M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, a => npowRec n a * a

C0_dependencies.name: instZHatCommRing
C0_dependencies.content:
/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.e
C0_dependencies.content:
open BigOperators Nat Finset in
/-- A nonarchimedean analogue `0! + 1! + 2! + ⋯` of `e = 1/0! + 1/1! + 1/2! + ⋯`.
It is defined as the function whose value at `ZMod n` is the sum of `i!` for `0 ≤ i < n`.-/
def e : ZHat := ⟨fun (n : ℕ+) ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n : ℕ), i !, by
  intros D N hDN
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_add_of_le <| le_of_dvd N.pos hDN
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_natCast, hk, sum_range_add, add_right_eq_self]
  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

lemma _root_.Nat.sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 < j) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := by
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < ∑ _i ∈ range (j + 1), j ! := ?_
    _ = (j + 1) * (j !) := by rw [sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = (j + 1)! := Nat.factorial_succ _
  apply sum_lt_sum (fun i hi => factorial_le <| by simpa only [mem_range, lt_succ] using hi) ?_
  use 0
  rw [factorial_zero]
  simp [hj]

    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega
      calc
        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_

      · gcongr

      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_

        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]

        mod_eq_of_lt this]

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

  | add x y hx hy =>

    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

  | n + 1, a => npowRec n a * a

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

  ext j

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by
  let r : ℕ := (z N : ZMod N).val

  rw [← multiples] at h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr

      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]

    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by

    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

      simpa using this

  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by

    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon

noncomputable def toQuaternion (z : 𝓞) : ℍ where

noncomputable def fromQuaternion (z : ℍ) : 𝓞 where
  re := Int.floor <| z.re + z.imJ
  im_o := Int.floor <| z.imJ + z.imK
  im_i := Int.floor <| z.imI - z.imK
  im_oi := Int.floor <| z.imJ - z.imK

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]

/-- A nonarchimedean analogue `0! + 1! + 2! + ⋯` of `e = 1/0! + 1/1! + 1/2! + ⋯`.
It is defined as the function whose value at `ZMod n` is the sum of `i!` for `0 ≤ i < n`.-/
def e : ZHat := ⟨fun (n : ℕ+) ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n : ℕ), i !, by
  intros D N hDN
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_add_of_le <| le_of_dvd N.pos hDN
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_natCast, hk, sum_range_add, add_right_eq_self]
  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

lemma _root_.Nat.sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 < j) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := by
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < ∑ _i ∈ range (j + 1), j ! := ?_
    _ = (j + 1) * (j !) := by rw [sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = (j + 1)! := Nat.factorial_succ _
  apply sum_lt_sum (fun i hi => factorial_le <| by simpa only [mem_range, lt_succ] using hi) ?_
  use 0
  rw [factorial_zero]
  simp [hj]

/-- Nonarchimedean $e$ is not an integer. -/
lemma e_not_in_Int : ∀ a : ℤ, e ≠ a := by
  rintro (a|a) ha
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, 1 < j ∧ a < ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! := by
      refine ⟨a + 2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lt_add_iff_pos_left, add_pos_iff, zero_lt_one, or_true]
      rw [sum_range_add]
      apply lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt
      · positivity
      rw [range_one, sum_singleton, add_zero]
      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega
      calc
        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_
      · rw [mul_one]
        have : 3 ≤ a + 3 := by omega
        have := sum_factorial_lt_two_mul_factorial this
        gcongr
      · rw [add_zero]
        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]
        ring
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    calc
      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_
      _ = (e N).val := ?_
    · dsimp [N]
      apply lt_sub_of_add_lt
      rwa [add_comm, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast,
        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]
    · have : a + 1 < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hj
      rw [ha, intCast_val, Int.cast_negSucc, ZMod.neg_val, ZMod.val_natCast, if_neg,
        mod_eq_of_lt this]
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      contrapose! this
      apply le_of_dvd (zero_lt_succ a) this

theorem eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero (N : ℕ+) (a : ZHat) (ha : N * a = 0) : a = 0 := by
  ext j
  rw [zero_val, ← a.prop j (N * j) (by simp)]
  apply torsionfree_aux
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left N.pos
  rw [← PNat.mul_coe]
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
  have : N * a (N * j) = 0 := by
    have : ((N : ZHat) * a) (N * j) = 0 := by simp [ha]
    exact this -- missing lemma
  simpa only [ZMod.val_mul, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_mul_mod, ZMod.val_zero] using congrArg ZMod.val this

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by
  let r : ℕ := (z N : ZMod N).val
  have h : (z - r) N = 0 := by change z N - r = 0; simp [r]
  rw [← multiples] at h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

      have := congrArg (TensorProduct.lid ℤ ZHat) h
      simpa using this

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma rat_meet_zHat : ratsub ⊓ zHatsub = zsub := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at hl hr
    rcases lowestTerms x with ⟨⟨N, z, hNz, hx⟩, unique⟩
    have cop1 : IsCoprime l.den.toPNat' l.num := by
      simp_rw [IsCoprime, ZHat.intCast_val, ← ZMod.isUnit_natAbs, ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime,
        PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos]
      exact l.reduced
    have cop2 : IsCoprime 1 r := by
      simp only [IsCoprime, PNat.val_ofNat]
      exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
    have hcanon : x = (1/(l.den : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.num : ZHat) := by
      nth_rw 1 [← hl, ← Rat.num_div_den l, ← mul_one ((l.num : ℚ) / l.den), div_mul_comm,
      mul_comm, ← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [← PNat.toPNat'_coe l.den_pos, hx] at hcanon
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := unique _ _ _ _ ⟨hNz, cop1, hcanon⟩
    have : 1 = 1 / (((1 : ℕ+) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp
    nth_rw 1 [← hx, ← hr, this] at hcanon
    use l.num; rw [hx, (unique _ 1 _ r ⟨hNz, cop2, hcanon.symm⟩).1]
    simp
  · exact fun x ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ by constructor <;> (use k; simp; exact hk)

C0_dependencies.name: QHat.rat_join_zHat
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma rat_join_zHat : ratsub ⊔ zHatsub = ⊤ := by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  rcases x.canonicalForm with ⟨N, z, hNz⟩
  rcases ZHat.nat_dense N z with ⟨q, r, hz, _⟩
  have h : z - r = N * q := sub_eq_of_eq_add hz
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_sup]
  use ((r : ℤ) / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] 1
  constructor
  · simp
  use 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q
  constructor
  · simp
  nth_rw 1 [← mul_one ((r : ℤ) / N : ℚ), div_mul_comm,
    mul_comm, ← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have : 1 = 1 / (N : ℚ) * (N : ℤ) := by simp
  nth_rw 2 [this]
  rw [mul_comm, ← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  norm_cast; rw [← h, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  simp [hNz]

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

    simp only [zero_zsmul, zsmulRec, neg, nsmul, negSucc_zsmul]

    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega

        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_

        gcongr

        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]

      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_

        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]

        mod_eq_of_lt this]

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>

    simp

    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩

lemma preserves_zsmul {G H : Type*} [Zero G] [Add G] [Neg G] [SMul ℕ G] [SubNegMonoid H]
    (f : G → H) (nsmul : ∀ (g : G) (n : ℕ), f (n • g) = n • f g)
    (neg : ∀ x, f (-x) = - f x)
    (z : ℤ) (g : G) :
    f (zsmulRec (· • ·) z g) = z • f g := by
  induction z with
  | hz =>
    simp only [zero_zsmul, zsmulRec, neg, nsmul, negSucc_zsmul]
    exact zero_nsmul (f g)
  | hp n =>
    simp only [zsmulRec, neg, nsmul, negSucc_zsmul]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    sorry
  | hn n =>
    simp only [zsmulRec, neg, nsmul]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    sorry

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: instZHatCommRing

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD

  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

C0_dependencies.name: ZHat.multiples
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma multiples (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : (∃ (y : ZHat), N * y = z) ↔ z N = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hy]
    change N * (y N) = 0
    simp [ZMod.natCast_self]
  · intro h
    let y : ZHat := {
      val := fun j ↦ (z (N * j)).val / (N : ℕ)
      property := by
        intro j k hjk
        have hj := z.prop N (N * j) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        have hk := z.prop N (N * k) (by simp only [PNat.mul_coe, dvd_mul_right])
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hj
        rw [h, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hk
        have hNjk := z.prop (N * j) (N * k) (mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl _) hjk)
        rw [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val] at hNjk
        simp only [PNat.mul_coe, map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat]
        apply Nat.ModEq.mul_right_cancel' (c := N) (by simp)
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hj, Nat.div_mul_cancel hk,
          mul_comm (j : ℕ) (N : ℕ), ← ZMod.eq_iff_modEq_nat, hNjk]
        simp
    }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    ext j
    exact y_mul_N_eq_z N z h j

lemma nat_dense (N : ℕ+) (z : ZHat) : ∃ (q : ZHat) (r : ℕ), z = N * q + r ∧ r < N := by
  let r : ℕ := (z N : ZMod N).val
  have h : (z - r) N = 0 := by change z N - r = 0; simp [r]
  rw [← multiples] at h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, by linear_combination -hq, ZMod.val_lt (z N)⟩

lemma canonicalForm (z : QHat) : ∃ (N : ℕ+) (z' : ZHat), z = (1 / N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ z' := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    simp
  | tmul q z =>
    refine ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos ⟩, q.num * z, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp only [PNat.mk_coe, zsmul_eq_mul]
    simp only [← q.mul_den_eq_num, LinearMap.mul_apply', mul_assoc,
      one_div, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.den_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, z₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, z₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N₁ * N₂, (N₁ : ℤ) * z₂ + (N₂ : ℤ) * z₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul,

    simp only [one_div, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, PNat.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr
    simp [mul_comm]

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

/-- We define the profinite completion of ℤ explicitly as compatible elements of ℤ/Nℤ for
all positive integers `N`. We declare it as a subring of `∏_{N ≥ 1} (ℤ/Nℤ)`, and then promote it
to a type. -/
def ZHat : Type := {
  carrier := { f : Π M : ℕ+, ZMod M | ∀ (D N : ℕ+) (h : (D : ℕ) ∣ N),
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod D) (f N) = f D },
  zero_mem' := by simp
  neg_mem' := fun {x} hx => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.neg_apply] at *
    peel hx with D N hD hx
    rw [ZMod.cast_neg hD, hx]
  add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_add hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  one_mem' := by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_one hD]
  mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.mul_apply] at *
    intro D N hD
    rw [ZMod.cast_mul hD, ha _ _ hD, hb _ _ hD]
  : Subring (Π n : ℕ+, ZMod n)}
deriving CommRing

C0_dependencies.content:
open BigOperators Nat Finset in
/-- A nonarchimedean analogue `0! + 1! + 2! + ⋯` of `e = 1/0! + 1/1! + 1/2! + ⋯`.
It is defined as the function whose value at `ZMod n` is the sum of `i!` for `0 ≤ i < n`.-/
def e : ZHat := ⟨fun (n : ℕ+) ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n : ℕ), i !, by
  intros D N hDN
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_add_of_le <| le_of_dvd N.pos hDN
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_natCast, hk, sum_range_add, add_right_eq_self]
  refine sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact Nat.dvd_factorial D.pos le_self_add
⟩

lemma _root_.Nat.sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 < j) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := by
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < ∑ _i ∈ range (j + 1), j ! := ?_
    _ = (j + 1) * (j !) := by rw [sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = (j + 1)! := Nat.factorial_succ _
  apply sum_lt_sum (fun i hi => factorial_le <| by simpa only [mem_range, lt_succ] using hi) ?_
  use 0
  rw [factorial_zero]
  simp [hj]

lemma _root_.Nat.sum_factorial_lt_two_mul_factorial {j : ℕ} (hj : 3 ≤ j) :

  induction j, hj using Nat.le_induction with

  | succ j hj ih =>
    rw [two_mul] at ih ⊢
    rw [sum_range_succ]
    gcongr

C0_dependencies.content:
/-- Nonarchimedean $e$ is not an integer. -/
lemma e_not_in_Int : ∀ a : ℤ, e ≠ a := by
  rintro (a|a) ha
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, 1 < j ∧ a < ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! := by
      refine ⟨a + 2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lt_add_iff_pos_left, add_pos_iff, zero_lt_one, or_true]
      rw [sum_range_add]
      apply lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt
      · positivity
      rw [range_one, sum_singleton, add_zero]
      exact (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right two_pos).trans_le (self_le_factorial _)
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    have h₀ : ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1) ! := sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt
    calc
      _ = _ := by simp [ha, N, mod_eq_of_lt (hj.trans h₀)]
      _ < _ := hj
      _ = _ := by simp only [PNat.mk_coe, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt h₀, N]
  · obtain ⟨j, honelt, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 1 < j ∧ (a + 1) + ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), i ! < (j + 1)! := by
      refine ⟨a + 3, ?_, ?_⟩
      · omega
      calc
        _ < (a + 1) * 1 + 2 * (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + 0 := ?_
        _ < (a + 1) * (a + 3)! + 2 * (a + 3)! + (a + 3)! := ?_
        _ = (a + 4)! := ?_
      · rw [mul_one]
        have : 3 ≤ a + 3 := by omega
        have := sum_factorial_lt_two_mul_factorial this
        gcongr
      · rw [add_zero]
        have : 1 ≤ (a + 3)! := Nat.one_le_of_lt (factorial_pos _)
        gcongr
      · gcongr
        exact factorial_pos _
      · rw [factorial_succ (a + 3)]
        ring
    let N : ℕ+ := ⟨(j + 1)!, by positivity⟩
    apply lt_irrefl (e N).val
    calc
      _ < N - (a + 1) := ?_
      _ = (e N).val := ?_
    · dsimp [N]
      apply lt_sub_of_add_lt
      rwa [add_comm, e_factorial_succ, ZMod.val_natCast,
        mod_eq_of_lt (sum_factorial_lt_factorial_succ honelt)]
    · have : a + 1 < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hj
      rw [ha, intCast_val, Int.cast_negSucc, ZMod.neg_val, ZMod.val_natCast, if_neg,
        mod_eq_of_lt this]
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      contrapose! this
      apply le_of_dvd (zero_lt_succ a) this

  ext j
  rw [zero_val, ← a.prop j (N * j) (by simp)]
  apply torsionfree_aux
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left N.pos
  rw [← PNat.mul_coe]
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
  have : N * a (N * j) = 0 := by
    have : ((N : ZHat) * a) (N * j) = 0 := by simp [ha]
    exact this -- missing lemma
  simpa only [ZMod.val_mul, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_mul_mod, ZMod.val_zero] using congrArg ZMod.val this
